_comment: The coding agent's CLI and model, released together (red-team #15). A model can refuse an older CLI, and a CLI can drop a model, so neither changes alone. 'verified' records the last real run of exactly this pair; changing 'cli' or 'model' without a new real run leaves it stale, and agent_pair.py and the eval gate then refuse the pair. Code owners review every change.
